| where Timestamp > ago(30d)

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

| append [

]

4003.def:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "node.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bnode(\.exe)?\b\S*\s+\.(\s|$)"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","npm.cmd","npm.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd")

| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
4003.sent:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\node.exe"
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bnode(\.exe)?\b\S*\s+\.(\s|$)"
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("node.exe","npm","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","yarn","pnpm")
| where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

description: Detects a Celery worker Python process spawning a shell or recon binary, the post-exploitation footprint of the CVE-2021-23727 stored command injection in celery.backends.base.Backend.exception_to_python.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/python-rce-vulnerability/
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q4xr-rc97-m4xx
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'celery'
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/id'
      - '/whoami'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
  condition: selection
level: high
4073.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python","python3","python3.8","python3.9","python3.10","python3.11") AND Processes.parent_process="*celery*" AND Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","id","whoami","uname","curl","wget","nc","ncat")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime

description: Detects the Sequelize ORM JSON-path key SQL injection signature - the ')) AS DECIMAL)' cast-break paired with a UNION SELECT / VERSION() probe - in inbound web request URIs.
